title: 验证卷 #2 · 情态被动 / 不规则分词 / 主谓一致
topic: IELTS 话题语境变式（第二轮）
goal: 验证卷#1 仍未过关的三个点换语境再考：①情态动词被动（be 不能漏）②rise 等不规则动词的分词 ③主谓一致（one of / the number of / 动名词主语）。全对才算过关。

questions.prompt: Food waste in school canteens ____ (should / address) immediately.
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动 = should + be + 过去分词：should be addressed。口诀：情态动词 + be + V-ed，be 不能省。

questions.prompt: All personal data ____ (must / protect) under the new privacy law.
questions.explanation: must be protected：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。上一题 should，这题 must，结构完全一样。

questions.prompt: The number of remote workers ____ (rise) steadily since 2020.
questions.explanation: ①since 2020 → 现在完成时 has + 过去分词；②rise 是不规则动词 rise-rose-risen，分词是 risen；③the number of + 复数名词，主语核心是 the number（单数）→ has。

questions.prompt: Since the subway opened, the use of private cars in the city centre ____ (decline) by 30%.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点 → 现在完成时；the use of private cars 主语核心是 use（单数）→ has declined。

questions.prompt: One of the main challenges facing modern cities ____ (be) traffic congestion.
questions.explanation: one of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语：主语核心是 one → is。不要被 challenges 带偏。
